title: Complete source-record index and bounded comparisons
scope: 15 complete records selected by the completed independent general audit; comparison summaries do not replace source definitions, prerequisites or exclusions.
null_convention: null means the field is absent on the source row; it does not mean no effect.

records.meaning: Frame an already lifted edge and narrowing contact-shadow gap over the same supporting plane.
records.conditions_and_limits: Acting contact, deformation boundary, exposed underside and lifted edge must already exist. Only framing changes; no new deformation or action. No explicit property-effect rows, so arbitrary partial composition locks are not automatically compatible.
records.comparison: The clearest explicit boundary between retained physical commitments and a positive framing change.

records.meaning: A handleable environmental layer responds continuously to an established actor’s manipulation.
records.conditions_and_limits: The person and sheet already belong to the core; operation and material response must be open. A locked different operation or incompatible rigid/flexible geometry excludes adoption. Keep the same sheet and owner.
records.comparison: Physical relations coexist with action+material effects; its permission to refine action does not transfer to designs that require the operation unchanged.

records.meaning: Water branches divide around sediment bars and visibly rejoin downstream.
records.conditions_and_limits: Branches, bars and downstream reconnections are joint visible commitments; branches without reconnection are partial.
records.comparison: Directed spatial geography is authored under setting/spatial_structure without relationship.

records.meaning: A liquid’s curved meniscus meets the vessel’s inner wall while retaining the continuous central level.
records.conditions_and_limits: Preserve the same wall contact and the typical concave water/glass boundary; a convex meniscus, gel or lens is outside the stated definition.
records.comparison: Physical interface contact can be authored under relationship. Already-retained pan contact cannot itself justify a new contact effect in a cleanup refinement.

records.meaning: A continuous thin water film covers the selected surface, with local reflections and visible underlying material.
records.conditions_and_limits: Keep the carrier’s identity; do not substitute independent droplets or turn it into glass or metal.
records.comparison: A covers relation is material-only here; relation vocabulary does not determine effects.

records.meaning: A crack network bounds connected sediment plates on one coherent drying surface.
records.conditions_and_limits: Retain polygon connectivity and sediment between cracks; waves, cement joints and reptile scales cannot substitute.
records.comparison: Region geometry can be material-only. The wet-named property on dry sediment is coarse nomenclature, not a formal semantic definition.

records.meaning: A continuous water-stain or sediment line marks a readable carrier with a boundary consistent with the specified trace.
records.conditions_and_limits: Distinguish a current water surface, past inundation trace and gloss stripe. Event date and cause require separate context.
records.comparison: Trace-source continuity is explicitly relational here, supporting conservative source/receiver scope without proving all residue alignment requires it.

records.meaning: A bounded transferred wet mark interrupts the same material, with adjacent wet/dry areas and reflections confined to wet regions.
records.conditions_and_limits: Do not compare different objects or imply material replacement merely through gloss.
records.comparison: Local extent and same-material ownership do not by themselves exclude relationship; this row declares trace_source_continuity.

records.meaning: A single waterline separates air/water views while the same objects continue across it.
records.conditions_and_limits: Retain water-context prerequisites and coherent shared-object continuity. Reject collage, mirror symmetry, two waterlines, or changing requester crop to evade the requirement.
records.comparison: Continuity is authored under camera+composition; this does not authorize relocating objects or changing a cleanup design’s already-established view.

records.meaning: Hair remains connected to the specified scalp while suspended in water.
records.conditions_and_limits: Requires a human and water-related primary context, with the same scalp; strands need not fan uniformly. Broad tags alone do not establish an underwater scene or authorize new setting/pose effects.
records.comparison: Attachment and suspension relations appear under appearance only; semantic prerequisites still require review.

records.meaning: Settled room dust and a fresh hand-width clean streak form a jointly visible comparison.
records.conditions_and_limits: Keep all comparison owners and components. Pixels do not prove smell or air age; poverty cannot be equated with horror.
records.comparison: Material/residue plus setting/objects without relationship supports a conservative residue-distribution convention, not blanket omission for all transfers.

records.meaning: An operator’s directed gesture targets a bounded center whose exact boundary is marked by objects.
records.conditions_and_limits: Keep operator, target and marked boundary together; random candles are insufficient, and real religious tools are not inherently evil.
records.comparison: Wildcard spatial_relation accompanies an actor-target commitment. Whether newly arranging boundary objects also needs setting is not settled by its declaration.

records.meaning: A pursuer occupies the route behind another adult while an obstruction closes an escape branch.
records.conditions_and_limits: Preserve all owners and components; a weapon portrait or added gore cannot substitute.
records.comparison: Directed role/spatial geometry can jointly affect action, relationship, count and setting. Cleanup designs preserve actors and apparatus and cannot borrow this row’s extra permissions.

records.meaning: Person A presents a phone to B, who attends to the same screen and visibly responds.
records.conditions_and_limits: No explicit property-effect rows or prerequisite limiting the action, participants and phone to already-established entities.
records.comparison: Social interaction is relationship-only in this authored row, but that is not a complete-effect gold standard if adoption creates action, expression, a person or a prop.

records.meaning: A human-only partner-role candidate whose relation/effect fields are not explicitly authored on the row.
records.conditions_and_limits: The partner_role slot has authored relationship ownership; semantic_source uses that fallback. Missing row fields must not be interpreted as no effects.
records.comparison: Relationship can be affected without a stored relations array.
